verdict.rationale: Gemini's own docs say users can turn off Keep Activity, delete their activity, and choose whether Google uses their audio and Live video or screenshares to improve its services. That is a first-party opt-out of activity tracking and data use for model improvement. However, nothing documents opting out of app telemetry, diagnostics or usage analytics as such. missing for 10: explicit telemetry/diagnostics/analytics opt-out, documentation that turning off Keep Activity stops all usage tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: You can review your prompts, delete your Gemini Apps activity, and turn off Keep Activity in My Activity at any time.
You can let Google use your audio and Gemini Live videos and screenshares to improve and develop its services, including training generative AI models.
Your chats and uploaded files in Gemini Apps won’t be reviewed by human reviewers or otherwise used to improve generative AI models.
